scientific_integrity: The general Walsh projection-kernel identity is cited as known. The new statement is the explicit all-unicyclic parity evaluation. Finite exact computations corroborate, but do not replace, the all-size analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Real finite simple graphs with exactly one cycle; not a formula for multicyclic graphs, weighted kernels, or complex projection constants; unindexed equivalent moment identities remain a bibliographic risk.
title: An exact cycle-parity law for Walsh projection constants of unicyclic graphs
